instruction: I'm working on a phonics activity focusing on double letters. Can you color all words that contain consecutive identical letters (like 'too', 'see', 'well') in green? This will help students identify double letter patterns.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires coloring words with double letters (consecutive identical characters) in green. The evaluator checks words in both the main document body paragraphs and tables for double letters using color difference calculation (CIEDE2000). Words with double letters in the document: 'all', 'well', 'soon', 'pretty', 'will', 'too'. Uses color distance threshold of 3.5 to allow for minor variations in green color.
